name: Falken's Maze
summary: A maze under fog: you see only where you have been. WOPR watches which way you turn and moves walls you have not seen yet.
howToPlay: Walk the @ from START at the top left to the [] EXIT at the bottom right.
Each key press moves one cell. A wall stops you.
Every 6 moves WOPR moves a wall you have not seen. Walls you have seen never change, and the exit always stays reachable.
Press Q to give up. WOPR tells you how far away the exit was.

controls.does: move one cell up, down, left or right
move up, left, down or right
leave the game and go back to WOPR

tips: WOPR blocks the turn you take most often, so mix your left and right turns.
WOPR moves at most 12 walls in a game. After that the maze stays put.
Dead ends you have seen stay dead ends, so search only the fog.

screenshots.caption: The start: all fog except the first cell, with the exit at the bottom right.
WOPR has moved 8 walls and says which way you like to turn.
Out: the exit found in 52 moves.
